title: dam sent answer
description: What dam new, dam edit and dam done print with --json or --toon when DAM_TOKEN is set. The item waits for the owner. A refusal is an error document instead.

answer.description: new and changed store an item; duplicate stores nothing and names the item that already says the same.

oid.description: The object the item makes or changes. For a new item it equals hash.

id.description: The tool's own id, when it passed --id.
